name: David Lynch
description: Pace Gallery presents a major exhibition of work by David Lynch, highlighting his vision across media with paintings, sculptures, watercolors, and early short films. The show includes a series of photographs taken in Berlin, touching on Lynch's history with the German capital and Europe at large. This presentation precedes a major retrospective and offers a rare opportunity to see the full breadth of Lynch's artistic practice beyond his renowned filmmaking. The exhibition reveals Lynch as a true multimedia artist whose visual language has profoundly influenced contemporary culture.
